MANOJ SUNDAR SAHOO

BUSINESS ANALYST | QA MANAGER | BFSI PAYMENTS

Bengaluru, India ▪ +91 9741120213 ▪ manojsahoocareers@gmail.com ▪ LinkedIn

Technical Business Analyst with 13+ years of experience (7+ years as a Business Analyst) in Banking and Financial Services (BFSI), specializing in Digital Banking, Payments, API Integration, Technical Solutioning, Requirement Engineering, Agile Delivery, and Stakeholder Management. Experienced in translating business requirements into technical specifications, API documentation, process flows, and solution designs while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise banking solutions.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to gather business requirements, define API integration requirements, document functional specifications, and support end-to-end solution delivery across banking applications.

Adept at translating business requirements into actionable user stories, conducting gap and impact analyses and ensuring regulatory compliance across mission-critical financial systems.

Recognized for driving high-quality software releases, mentoring teams and aligning QA strategy with organizational goals to enhance delivery efficiency and customer satisfaction.

 Achieved 30% reduction in post-certification defect leakage within two release cycles by revamping the validation

process, enhancing test coverage, and implementing strategic cross-functional quality improvements.

 Successfully delivered complex tax year scenarios and reports for Sainsbury Bank ahead of schedule, achieving 100%

client acceptance and zero defects, enhancing trust and securing future projects.

 Delivered flawless eDAO module on time, achieving 40% reduction in onboarding time, while enhancing client

satisfaction and solidifying our role as a digital transformation leader.

 Successfully delivered Transaction Alerts module on time and within budget, reducing post-production incidents by

25%, enhancing real-time customer engagement and trust for financial institutions.

CORE EXPERTISE

Business Analysis • Payment Systems • Process Mapping • • Data Analysis & Reporting • Agile & Scrum Leadership • Gap Analysis & Impact Assessment • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

Stakeholder Management & Communication

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE FIS, Bengaluru

Product Backlog Management & Prioritization • Regulatory & Risk Compliance • Quality Assurance & Testing • • Test Planning & Execution • Defect Tracking & Root Cause Analysis • Quality Process Improvement • Gap & Impact Analysis Aug 2012 – Sep 2025

Functional, Regression, Integration & UAT Testing

Growth path: BUSINESS ANALYST (Mar 2018 – Sep 2025) QA ENGG (Aug 2012 – Feb 2018)

As Business Analyst • Partnered with Product Owners to refine and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives

and sprint goals.

Translated business requirements into Epics, User Stories, and Tasks in JIRA to support Agile delivery. • Collaborated with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to gather business requirements, define API integration requirements, document functional specifications, and support end-to-end solution delivery across banking applications.

Collaborated with business and technology teams to gather and document requirements for SWIFT payment processing, including MT/MX message formats, payment workflows, exception handling, and integration with core banking and payment systems.

MANOJ SUNDAR SAHOO ▪ +91 98808 30200 ▪ ms.sahoo@gmail.com

• Knowledge of AWS Cloud and cloud-based application architecture, with an understanding of cloud integration, APIs, data

flows, deployment, and application delivery.

Authored BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, API specifications, process flows, sequence diagrams, and data mapping documents

to support integration between upstream and downstream banking systems.

Performed SQL-based data validation and analysis to support requirement verification, production investigations, and

business reporting.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define exception handling, audit requirements, and integration workflows for

banking transaction processing.

Conducted gap analysis, feasibility studies, and impact assessments to support informed business and technical decision-





making. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Led UAT planning and execution by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with stakeholders, and supporting defect resolution during testing cycles.

Coordinated with developers, QA teams, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution delivery

and successful production releases.

Analyzed business and transaction data, prepared dashboards and reports, and provided insights to support business

decisions.

Worked with engineering teams to analyze event-driven integrations using Kafka topics for real-time transaction



processing and data exchange between banking applications. Identified process improvement opportunities by redesigning workflows, eliminating bottlenecks, and recommending automation initiatives.

Delivered Business Analysis support for global banking clients, including AMEX, CAX, FTB, ANZ, and SMBC, supporting

digital banking and payment solutions.

As QA Engg • Directed the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) across requirements analysis, testing, and implementation to ensure

successful software delivery.

Delivered multiple releases for MBP Core Banking Systems, ensuring application stability and reliability for global banking



clients. Implemented and validated PROFILE Core Banking modules across multiple deployments, ensuring application quality and production readiness.

Performed comprehensive manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, and system testing, while

implementing defect prevention strategies.

Optimized Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) processes to improve testing efficiency and streamline defect management. • Developed test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and test execution reports to ensure comprehensive requirement





coverage. Led defect triage meetings and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions, collaborating with development teams to resolve issues and prevent defect recurrence. Supported production deployments, application performance monitoring, and post-production validation for MBP Core Banking Systems.

Collaborated with business analysts, developers, and product teams to align quality assurance activities with business

requirements and product objectives.

Validated production readiness by performing release verification, regression testing, and deployment support across

global implementations.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) ▪ Berhampur University, Odisha B.Sc. – Physics ▪ Utkal University, Odisha

SAFe Certified Product Owner/Product Manager

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Collaborated with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to gather business requirements, define API integration requirements, document functional specifications, and support end-to-end solution delivery across banking applications.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE FIS, Bengaluru
Aug 2012 – Sep 2025
Growth path: BUSINESS ANALYST (Mar 2018 – Sep 2025) QA ENGG (Aug 2012 – Feb 2018)
As Business Analyst • Partnered with Product Owners to refine and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business objectives
and sprint goals.
Translated business requirements into Epics, User Stories, and Tasks in JIRA to support Agile delivery. • Collaborated with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to gather business requirements, define API integration requirements, document functional specifications, and support end-to-end solution delivery across banking applications.
Collaborated with business and technology teams to gather and document requirements for SWIFT payment processing, including MT/MX message formats, payment workflows, exception handling, and integration with core banking and payment systems.
• Knowledge of AWS Cloud and cloud-based application architecture, with an understanding of cloud integration, APIs, data
flows, deployment, and application delivery.
Authored BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, API specifications, process flows, sequence diagrams, and data mapping documents
to support integration between upstream and downstream banking systems.
Performed SQL-based data validation and analysis to support requirement verification, production investigations, and
business reporting.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define exception handling, audit requirements, and integration workflows for
banking transaction processing.
Conducted gap analysis, feasibility studies, and impact assessments to support informed business and technical decision-


making. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Led UAT planning and execution by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with stakeholders, and supporting defect resolution during testing cycles.
Coordinated with developers, QA teams, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution delivery
and successful production releases.
Analyzed business and transaction data, prepared dashboards and reports, and provided insights to support business
decisions.
Worked with engineering teams to analyze event-driven integrations using Kafka topics for real-time transaction

processing and data exchange between banking applications. Identified process improvement opportunities by redesigning workflows, eliminating bottlenecks, and recommending automation initiatives.
Delivered Business Analysis support for global banking clients, including AMEX, CAX, FTB, ANZ, and SMBC, supporting
digital banking and payment solutions.
As QA Engg • Directed the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) across requirements analysis, testing, and implementation to ensure
successful software delivery.
Delivered multiple releases for MBP Core Banking Systems, ensuring application stability and reliability for global banking

clients. Implemented and validated PROFILE Core Banking modules across multiple deployments, ensuring application quality and production readiness.
Performed comprehensive manual testing, including functional, regression, integration, and system testing, while
implementing defect prevention strategies.
Optimized Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) processes to improve testing efficiency and streamline defect management. • Developed test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and test execution reports to ensure comprehensive requirement


coverage. Led defect triage meetings and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) sessions, collaborating with development teams to resolve issues and prevent defect recurrence. Supported production deployments, application performance monitoring, and post-production validation for MBP Core Banking Systems.
Collaborated with business analysts, developers, and product teams to align quality assurance activities with business
requirements and product objectives.
Validated production readiness by performing release verification, regression testing, and deployment support across
global implementations.
